title: Abbas Abbas e Alamdaar sidhaara
body:
abbas abbas-e-alamdar sidhara
<<DIVIDER>>
shay kehte the duniya se yeh , mera bhai sidhara
abbas abbas-e-alamdar sidhara … 1. har simth se hain teer o sina barchiya bhale
abbas kaha ab jo mujhey aake sambhale
toota hain falak mujh mein nahi jeene ka yara
<<MINI>>
abbas abbas-e-alamdar sidhara
<<DIVIDER>>
2. karbal main akela huwa bin tere aye bhai
har gaam musibat huwa bin tere aye bhai
har zakh se aanch uthti hain jalta hain yeh sehra
<<MINI>>
abbas abbas-e-alamdar sidhara
<<DIVIDER>>
3. lakho the adoo aur akela tha wo sakha
youn nehr pe khabza kiya pyassa raha sakha
abbas se kab door tha dariya ka kinara
<<MINI>>
abbas abbas-e-alamdar sidhara
<<DIVIDER>>
4. poorsooz hain karbal ki fiza karti hain matam
moo ashkoun se dhoti hain wafa karti hain matam
nazaan thi wafa jispe wo dildaar sidhara
<<MINI>>
abbas abbas-e-alamdar sidhara
<<DIVIDER>>
5. maghmoom si dhankan hai to zakhmi si fikar hai
tooti hai kahin aas kahin chak jigar hain
abbas sa ghazzi o wafa daar sidhara
<<MINI>>
abbas abbas-e-alamdar sidhara
<<DIVIDER>>
6. har saans mein ab zikr tera karti hain zainab
ab apne hi bazzo ko takka karti hain zainab
duniya mein nahi koi bhi ab uska sahara
<<MINI>>
abbas abbas-e-alamdar sidhara
<<DIVIDER>>
7. be chain bohat rehti hain ab bali sakina
pani bhi nahi mangti ab bali sakina
veeraan si ankhoun mein hain bas aks tumhara
<<MINI>>
abbas abbas-e-alamdar sidhara
<<DIVIDER>>
8. kehti hain sakina yahi ba didaye purnam
pani na pohunchne ka hain ammu ko bohot gham
kya aysa koi karta hain duniya se kinara
<<MINI>>
abbas abbas-e-alamdar sidhara
<<DIVIDER>>
9. aajayengi wo dhundti maidan mein bibi
margayegi ghut ghut ke wo zindan mein bibi
ajaye usey sabr tumhe khoke khudara
<<MINI>>
abbas abbas-e-alamdar sidhara
<<DIVIDER>>
10. hai hai huwa be dast yeh bhai mera abbas
bin hatoun ke anna wo zameen par tera abbas
ek karb ka dariya hain nahi jiska sahara
<<MINI>>
abbas abbas-e-alamdar sidhara
<<DIVIDER>>
11. bhaiya tumhare saat gaya sabke dil ka chain
tanha hain ab hujoom mein zehra ka nooreain
abaad kiya tumne to dariya ka kinara
<<MINI>>
abbas abbas-e-alamdar sidhara
<<DIVIDER>>
12. bazoo yeh katte tere zameen se to uthaloun
tehro zara abbas gale se to lagaloun
kadmoun mein hai ab nehr bhi aur uska kinara
<<MINI>>
abbas abbas-e-alamdar sidhara
<<DIVIDER>>
13. ayi hain pasand tumko yeh dariya ki tarayi
khayesh hain yahi shair ka maskan ho tarayi
laasha bhi utha sakta nahi bhai tumhara
<<MINI>>
abbas abbas-e-alamdar sidhara
<<DIVIDER>>
14. sarwat yahi aati thi sada zehra ki ran se
zinda na phirega mera ghazi kabhi ran se
abbas e ali tha mere bachoun ka sahara
<<MINI>>
abbas abbas-e-alamdar sidhara
